name: 19560 · Temple, PA
findings: ZIP 19560 (Temple) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19560 (Temple) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19560 (Temple) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
